options.name: command
options.description: This is the well-formatted DBRC command to submit.

options.name: dbd_lib
options.description: The data set that contains the descriptions for the databases that are under the control of DBRC.

options.name: dynamic_allocation_dataset
options.description: The dynamic allocation data set that will be used to complete the DBRC execution. Required if `recon1`, `recon2`, and `recon3` are not specified.

options.name: genjcl_input_dataset
options.description: The PDS, which contains the skeletal JCL members used by the DBRC utility to generate JCL. Equivalent to the JCLPDS control statement.

options.name: genjcl_output_dataset
options.description: The data set which is to receive the generated JCL. It is required only for the GENJCL commands. Equivalent to the JCLOUT control statement.

options.name: max_rc
options.description: The maximum acceptable return code allowed for the module to complete succesfully.

options.name: recon1
options.description: The RECON1 data set that will be used to complete the DBRC execution. Required if `dynamic_allocation_dataset` is not specified.

options.name: recon2
options.description: The RECON2 data set that will be used to complete the DBRC execution. Required if `dynamic_allocation_dataset` is not specified.

options.name: recon3
options.description: The RECON3 data set that will be used to complete the DBRC execution. Required if `dynamic_allocation_dataset` is not specified.

options.name: steplib
options.description: List of STEPLIB datasets that contain the IMS nucleus and the required action modules.
